hadeethenc.label: No separate bank review required — owner decision
hadeethenc.note: This decision removes the separate Hadith Bank review requirement for HadeethEnc source imports. It does not assert that an independent review occurred, resolve source-version alignment notes, change publisher conditions, or authorize publication of other private materials. Historical import statuses remain in the canonical source records.

other_materials.note: Source-specific history is preserved. Authorized PDF and quotation-extraction publication manifests record public visibility, not a new independent review. The current reader display policy limits QC labels to evidenced OCR.

pdf_intakes.note: Owner-approved public access is recorded separately from original private-candidate history. No source fidelity, Arabic repair, translation accuracy, or reuse license is newly certified.

reader_display.ocr_classification_basis: Explicit ocr_used flags and structured extraction-method evidence; a PDF file type or translation origin is not OCR evidence.
reader_display.note: The reader shows QC labels only for OCR-derived text. Outsourced website text, native PDF text and exact digital quotation extraction do not receive generic pending-QC badges. Original source review, publication and rights fields remain preserved in record details.
